name: Pluto
description: Pluto is a benchmark and evaluation framework designed to assess the efficiency of LLM-generated Verilog hardware designs. It includes 114 problems with self-checking testbenches and multiple Pareto-optimal reference implementations, evaluating both functional correctness and synthesis metrics such as area, delay, and power efficiency.
reputation: A recent niche benchmark from the hardware-code generation literature, mainly used by researchers working on LLMs for Verilog rather than as a broad community standard.
notes: Evaluates synthesis efficiency metrics (area, delay, power) alongside functional correctness; highlights gap between LLM and expert-crafted designs.
